title: E.l.f. Beauty leaks CEO Tarang Amin’s number in marketing stunt
summary: The beauty giant is giving customers a direct line to its CEO via the ‘Dial 0 for Zero Distance’ campaign, where they can tell Amin what causes matter most to them and where e.l.f. Beauty can make a bigger impact
